title: The text SP-gea4jifz moved out of tools.md reads on its own in the docs it moved to
goal: No moved bullet in monitoring.md, plugin.md, web-sources.md or backlog.md refers to a row, bullet or subject that is no longer beside it, and each moved section does not repeat a section already in its doc

run:
import sys
probes = [('kb/_self/monitoring.md', '(above, in the `kb_mcp.py` row)'),
          ('kb/_self/plugin.md', '(below, "Revalidation at question time")'),
          ('kb/_self/web-sources.md', '\n- `--dry-run` prints that line'),
          ('kb/_self/backlog.md', '- And with neither,')]
left = [(d, p.strip()) for d, p in probes if p in open(d, encoding='utf-8').read()]
print('dangling references left:', left); sys.exit(1 if left else 0)
